description: Implementation of the e1ap_cu_cp module handling E1AP protocol messages, procedures, and UE context management for CU-CP in a 5G network, including message handling, procedure invocation, and logging.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_cp_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing E1AP CU-CP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and procedure coordination.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Helper class that wraps message notifications with logging functionality.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the CU-CP E1AP protocol handling.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Processes an E1 Reset message, initiating reset procedures or dropping if stopping.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_response
methods.description: Handles responses to CU-UP E1 setup, sending success or failure messages.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Handles bearer context setup requests, creating UE context and invoking setup procedures.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message dispatcher that processes incoming E1AP messages based on type.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Handles initial E1AP messages such as setup requests and release requests.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request
methods.description: Processes bearer context release requests from messages.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Handles inactivity notifications for bearer contexts, possibly releasing UE.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Handles successful outcome messages, updating UE context or transaction states.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Handles unsuccessful outcome messages, updating UE context or transaction states.

methods.name: cancel_ue_tasks
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing tasks for a specific UE.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Transfers UE context from an old to a new UE index.

methods.name: remove_bearer_context
methods.description: Removes UE context from internal storage.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs an E1AP protocol data unit, including UE identification.
